name: The Old Camera That Projects a Garden
description: A vintage film camera in a dark garden projects a glowing living garden of flowers and trees into the night air.
prompt: A vintage film camera on a wooden bench in a dark garden, its lens projecting a glowing living projection of blooming flowers and trees into the night air, no readable images, soft light, nostalgic, magical realism, cinematic, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: Some cameras don't record the past; they bring it back to bloom. What memory would you project tonight?
